(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 further comprising: __effectively__ displaying the filtered EPG information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to __any__ channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of the subscriber's channel identifiers of channels __that are__ accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: __effectively__ displaying the filtered EPG information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to __any__ channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of the subscriber's channel identifiers of channels __that are__ accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to __effectively__ display the filtered EPG information.
